title: ThermoRegister: temperature acquisition system for solution combustion synthesis
description: Hardware design, firmware and CAD files to reproduce the low-cost temperature measurement system used in the paper "Influence of Ammonium Nitrate in the Synthesis of Alpha Tricalcium Phosphates (α-TCP) in One Step by Solution Combustion" (International Journal of Self-Propagating High-Temperature Synthesis, 2023, 32(3), 192-199). The system records the reaction temperature with two type-K thermocouples and an infrared sensor.
